conservative.requirements: 7 power, target suffering from one or more corruption and within medium range. Special: You may purge up to 3 corruption from the target. If you do, add {Dc} to your dice pool for each corruption purged. Effect: The target's flesh ripples and twists, refusing to obey him. While this spell is recharging, his defence and soak values are reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 0).
